preconditioning.notes: Estimated: BMW iX release says "anticipatory thermal management enables the high-voltage battery's operating temperature to be optimised" (same wording as the i4, whose US page spells out the navigation trigger; manual control not addressed).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: InsideEVs (US coverage of the 2026 refresh): 100.1 kWh usable, BMW-reported (evspecifications and KBB relay the same set, M70 112.8). Conflict: the BMW global release gives 94.8 kWh usable energy content; the gap is 4-6 %.
BMW global release: usable energy content 94.8 kWh (launch text; the later 2026 refresh coverage quotes higher figures).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs says "the voltage architecture remains the same" as the 2025 iX (400 V class, ArenaEV).

dc_max_kw.notes: BMW global release: 175 kW (InsideEVs: 195 kW unchanged).

ac_max_kw.notes: evspecifications relaying BMW: AC up to 11 kW all models. BMW global release says up to 22 kW max (global). North America assumed 11 kW like the 2022-2025 iX.
